**2026-10-27.** A patch release with no engine change. The `ai-advanced` example no longer keeps a
webhook signing secret in its source. Everything in the v0.6.0 release notes applies.
There is no `q:` namespace change and no migration.

## Fixed: a dev-only secret that looked like a real one

The `ai-advanced` example runs a small model stub that signs the completion webhooks the engine
then verifies. Its signing secret was written into the example's compose file and into the
container test suite as a literal that began with `whsec_`. That is the prefix of a payment
provider's webhook signing secret, so GitHub secret scanning raised an alert on it.

The value was never a credential. It belonged to a local stub and protected nothing. It did,
however, match a real provider's pattern, and a package that treats secrets as references should
not carry anything that looks like a literal one.

- `examples/ai-advanced/deploy/compose.yaml` now reads `${STUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET:-<default>}` for the
  stub and for the engine. The default is plain base64 with no provider prefix, so the quick start
  still runs without any exports. Export `STUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to use your own.
- The container test suite for the AI examples generates a random secret for each run. No secret
  is kept in its source.

The webhook verifier accepts a secret with or without a `whsec_` prefix, so a secret you already
use keeps working. The engine, the packages and the wire formats are unchanged.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do. If you copied the old compose file, replace its `STUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` lines with
the form above.

## Install

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/startr-trade/sutra:0.6.3
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/startr-trade/sutra/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --version v0.6.3
```

The library crates are on crates.io as `sutra-feel = "0.6.3"` and `sutra-dmn = "0.6.3"`.
